description: Node built-ins the baseline dump does not cover and Vercel's Edge runtime lacks (the allowlist removes the rest), and JavaScript features it disables, applied by the vercel-edge target on top of the allowlist. eval and WebAssembly.compile are blocked. `new Function(string)` is blocked too and is listed as `Function.(string)`, the name edgefit gives a call of the Function constructor with code in an argument (`Function('return this')`, the global object idiom, is not counted). WebAssembly.instantiate is blocked only for buffer sources, so it is listed as `WebAssembly.instantiate.(bytes)`, a call whose first argument is not an imported module. A `require` whose module is computed at runtime is blocked too and is listed as `require.(dynamic)`. A static `require` is bundled, so it is not listed.

*globals*.eval.note: is disabled in the Edge runtime: dynamic code execution is not allowed

*globals*.WebAssembly.compile.note: is disabled in the Edge runtime: WebAssembly modules must come from an import, not a buffer

*globals*.WebAssembly.instantiate.(bytes.note: is disabled in the Edge runtime for a buffer source: import the .wasm file and pass the module

*globals*.require.(dynamic).note: is not allowed in the Edge runtime: a require call left for runtime does not work, use import

*globals*.Function.(string).note: is disabled in the Edge runtime: dynamic code execution is not allowed
